reason: The handler does filter only on `userId: user.id` (packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/calendars/deleteCache.handler.ts:17-22), but team-owned calendar credentials do not exist: calendar-category apps are excluded from team install (packages/app-store/utils.ts:161-165) and the Google Calendar callback always stores `userId: req.session.user.id` (packages/app-store/googlecalendar/api/callback.ts:75,109).
